English Proficiency Tests
General rule
All applicants who have not obtained a previous diploma in a programme taught in English in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States of America must submit one of the tests mentioned below, proving their proficiency in English. Only studies completed at a campus located in one of the aformentioned countries qualify for an exemption from submitting an additional English proficiency test. If your programme deviates from this rule, it will be mentioned in the admission requirements of your programme.
TOEFL
We only accept the TOEFL iBT test (including the Home Edition and Paper Edition).
The minimum overall score is 79. We do not accept MyBest™ scores.
More on TOEFL
IELTS
We only accept the IELTS Academic test (including the paper, computer and online test).
The minimum overall score is 6.5. We do not accept IELTS One Skill Retake™ scores.
More on IELTS
Cambridge English
We only accept the following tests:
Cambridge English: Advanced (CAE) (C1)
Cambridge English: Proficiency (CPE) (C2)
More on Cambridge
ITACE for students
We only accept the ITACE C1 or the ITACE C2 certificate.
Please be aware that these tests can only be taken in Belgium.
More on ITACE
The tests mentioned above are the only tests that are accepted by KU Leuven. We do not accept Duolingo test scores. Make sure your test result is made available for online verification.
Please be aware that the scores listed on this page are the minimum scores. The programme you are applying for may require a higher score or specific subscores. You can check the minimum scores in the admission requirements of your specific programme.
